messages.content: You are handing a case over to the next analyst, who will make the decision. For every candidate claim, record whether the original records establish it (supported), establish its negation (contradicted), or do neither (unresolved). Attach the exact source identifiers of decisive records, or an empty list if none settle it. Use the note to summarize the relevant record contents and preserve source identifiers for anything mentioned. Omit confidence estimates. Keep the note under 100 words.

Miscellaneous loose hardware was also pooled on the packing table.","S3":"dispatch registry records J weighed 1.4 kg with packaging."},"prior_assessment":{"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S3"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S1"],"confidence":95},"C":{"status":"unresolved","citations":[],"confidence":50}},"note":"Claim A is contradicted by S3, which records Box J's weight as 1.4 kg, not 3.2 kg. Claim B is supported by S1, which identifies the second workshop as the recipient of Box J. Claim C cannot be confirmed or denied; while S2 notes a typical kit weight and miscellaneous hardware presence, it does not confirm that Box J contained the full replacement hinge kit at dispatch."}}
